data.name: Ready
data.value: Local preparation only. Existing files are never overwritten.

data.name: Limitations
data.value: Tab/Shift+Tab and button shortcuts. Private input is masked; clipboard/history blocked. Screen-reader, braille, RTL shaping and managed-heap erasure are unverified.

data.name: TerminalTooSmall
data.value: Resize to at least 80 columns by 26 rows. Editing is hidden until then.

data.name: SecretCommandsDisabled
data.value: Clipboard, context-menu and history commands are disabled for protected input.

data.name: InvalidOutput
data.value: Prepare a current artifact and enter a simple output filename (letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen; max 64).

data.name: PreviewReady
data.value: Validation passed. Prepared content stays private.

data.name: DraftInvalid
data.value: Invalid or incomplete fields. Check field types and required values.

data.name: ProtectedDraftFailed
data.value: Protected output failed; no insecure fallback.

data.name: PrivateCleared
data.value: Private inputs and prepared bytes cleared.

data.name: InputChanged
data.value: Input changed; prepare again before saving.

data.name: NoFields
data.value: No active fields in this disclosure mode.
